name: Bhagavad Gita 8.7
text:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः ॥
meaning: Therefore remember me at all times, and do your work. With mind and understanding offered to me, you will surely come to me.
purpose: Remembering what matters while continuing to act.
when: At the start of a working day.
note: The client list’s transcription (“Tasmaat Sarveshu Kaleshu…”) was garbled; this is the verse as it stands in the Gita.
